title: Sr. Director and Actuary (Morristown, NJ (Hybrid) or Remote)

cond_0001.intro: As a Sr. Director and Actuary, you'll support variable and fixed annuity asset liability management and risk assessment. This role reports to the Head of Strategic Analysis with a focus on hedge strategy enhancement, modeling, risk analysis, and documentation. This individual will support the asset liability management team in creating tools to identify and measure the risk factors to earnings from product lines with embedded market risk. The individual will play a leading role in developing, improving, documenting hedge related analysis. The individual will require strong technical skill in model building, big data processing, analysis using MS Office, database and various programming language.
cond_0001.responsibilities:
Be a thought leader in hedging and risk management of variable annuities with living benefit riders (VA), fixed annuities (FA), and structured indexed annuities (SIA), IUL, through hedge strategy enhancement, capital and reserve determination, as well as product design and pricing.
Create and maintain models/tools which can perform business analysis with quick turnaround.
Identify and measure the impact to hedging program from risk factors, including but not limited to actuarial, market, regulatory change.
Propose enhancement and alteration to hedge procedure, instrument selection and hedge target based on risk analysis.
Improve attribution analysis with the focus to improve hedge effectiveness.
Document modeling approach, assumptions and core results.
Coordinate with business constituents in maintaining consistency in production process, implementation schedule, assumptions, modeling approach and regulatory and reporting.
cond_0001.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Degree in mathematics, statistics, or actuarial science
Fellowship of Society of Actuaries
Deep knowledge base on VA business, reporting and hedging
Strong computing and programming skills with experience in Python, C/C++, Matlab, VBA, SQL, etc.
Preferred Requirements
Adaptable to business priorities
Strong communication skills
cond_0001.encouragement_text: Important: Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply.
cond_0001.values: We value work that is useful to others and carried out with care. We believe strong organizations pay attention not only to outcomes, but also to how those outcomes affect people.

cond_0179.intro: We are looking for a Sr. Director and Actuary to join our team.
cond_0179.responsibilities:
As a Sr. Director and Actuary, you'll own variable and fixed annuity asset liability management and risk assessment. This role reports to the Head of Strategic Analysis with a focus on hedge strategy enhancement, modeling, risk analysis, and documentation. You will lead the asset liability management team in building tools to identify and measure the risk factors to earnings from product lines with embedded market risk. You will take ownership of developing, improving, and documenting hedge-related analysis, bringing strong technical skill in model building, big data processing, and analysis using MS Office, database tools, and various programming languages.
Be a thought leader in hedging and risk management of variable annuities with living benefit riders (VA), fixed annuities (FA), and structured indexed annuities (SIA), IUL, through hedge strategy enhancement, capital and reserve determination, as well as product design and pricing.
Build and maintain models/tools that deliver business analysis with quick turnaround.
Identify and measure the impact to the hedging program from risk factors, including but not limited to actuarial, market, and regulatory change.
Determine enhancements and alterations to hedge procedure, instrument selection, and hedge target based on risk analysis.
Drive improvement in attribution analysis with the focus to improve hedge effectiveness.
Document modeling approach, assumptions, and core results.
Lead coordination with business constituents to maintain consistency in production process, implementation schedule, assumptions, modeling approach, and regulatory and reporting.
cond_0179.requirements:
Degree in mathematics or statistics, or actuarial science
Fellowship of Society of Actuaries
Strong computing and programming skills with experience in Python, c/c++, Matlab, VBA, SQL, etc.
Deep knowledge base on VA business, reporting and hedging.
Adaptable to business priorities
Strong communication skills

This role reports to the Head of Strategic Analysis with a focus on hedge strategy enhancement, modeling, risk analysis, and documentation. This individual will support the asset liability management team in creating tools to identify and measure the risk factors to earnings from product lines with embedded market risk. The individual will play a leading role in developing, improving, documenting hedge related analysis. The individual will require strong technical skill in model building, big data processing, analysis using MS Office, database and various programming language.
Be a thought leader in hedging and risk management of variable annuities with living benefit riders (VA), fixed annuities (FA), and structured indexed annuities (SIA), IUL, through hedge strategy enhancement, capital and reserve determination, as well as product design and pricing. Create and maintain models/tools which can perform business analysis with quick turnaround. Identify and measure the impact to hedging program from risk factors, including but not limited to actuarial, market, regulatory change. Propose enhancement and alteration to hedge procedure, instrument selection and hedge target based on risk analysis. Improve attribution analysis with the focus to improve hedge effectiveness. Document modeling approach, assumptions and core results. Coordinate with business constituents in maintaining consistency in production process, implementation schedule, assumptions, modeling approach and regulatory and reporting.
cond_0210.requirements:
Degree in mathematics, statistics, or actuarial science, or equivalent practical experience.
Fellowship of Society of Actuaries, or willingness to obtain.
Working knowledge of computing and programming, with experience in Python, C/C++, Matlab, VBA, SQL, or similar tools.
Background in VA business, reporting, and hedging.
Ability to adapt to shifting business priorities.
Ability to communicate effectively with colleagues and stakeholders.
cond_0210.values: We value work that is useful to others and carried out with care. We believe strong organizations pay attention not only to outcomes, but also to how those outcomes affect people.

cond_0326.intro: We are looking for a Sr. Director and Actuary to join our team.
cond_0326.responsibilities:
As a Sr. Director and Actuary, you'll support variable and fixed annuity asset liability management and risk assessment. This role reports to the Head of Strategic Analysis with a focus on hedge strategy enhancement, modeling, risk analysis, and documentation. This individual will support the asset liability management team in creating tools to identify and measure the risk factors to earnings from product lines with embedded market risk. The individual will play a leading role in developing, improving, documenting hedge related analysis. The individual will require strong technical skill in model building, big data processing, analysis using MS Office, database and various programming language.
Be a thought leader in hedging and risk management of variable annuities with living benefit riders (VA), fixed annuities (FA), and structured indexed annuities (SIA), IUL, through hedge strategy enhancement, capital and reserve determination, as well as product design and pricing. Create and maintain models/tools which can perform business analysis with quick turnaround. Identify and measure the impact to hedging program from risk factors, including but not limited to actuarial, market, regulatory change. Propose enhancement and alteration to hedge procedure, instrument selection and hedge target based on risk analysis. Improve attribution analysis with the focus to improve hedge effectiveness. Document modeling approach, assumptions and core results. Coordinate with business constituents in maintaining consistency in production process, implementation schedule, assumptions, modeling approach and regulatory and reporting.
cond_0326.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Degree in mathematics, statistics, or actuarial science required; advanced degree strongly preferred.
Fellowship of Society of Actuaries.
Deep expertise in VA business, reporting, and hedging.
Strong command of computing and programming, with demonstrated expertise in Python, C/C++, Matlab, VBA, SQL, or similar languages.
Preferred Requirements
Proven ability to adapt to shifting business priorities with minimal disruption to delivery.
Exceptional communication skills, with the ability to convey complex technical findings clearly to a range of stakeholders.

In this role, you'll support variable and fixed annuity asset liability management and risk assessment, reporting to the Head of Strategic Analysis. The focus is on hedge strategy enhancement, modeling, risk analysis, and documentation. You'll work closely with the asset liability management team, regularly connecting with colleagues to build tools that identify and measure risk factors to earnings from product lines with embedded market risk. Strong technical skills in model building, big data processing, and analysis using MS Office, databases, and various programming languages are central to the day-to-day work.
cond_0474.responsibilities:
Serve as a thought leader in hedging and risk management of variable annuities with living benefit riders (VA), fixed annuities (FA), structured indexed annuities (SIA), and IUL — actively contributing to hedge strategy enhancement, capital and reserve determination, product design, and pricing.
Build and maintain models and tools that support business analysis with quick turnarounds, staying in regular contact with stakeholders throughout the process.
Identify and measure the impact to the hedging program from risk factors, including actuarial, market, and regulatory changes, and speak up early when issues arise.
Propose enhancements and alterations to hedge procedures, instrument selection, and hedge targets based on risk analysis.
Improve attribution analysis with a focus on hedge effectiveness.
Document modeling approaches, assumptions, and core results clearly so others can follow and engage with the work.
Coordinate daily with business constituents to maintain consistency in production processes, implementation schedules, assumptions, modeling approaches, and regulatory and reporting requirements — initiating discussions to resolve gaps and keep alignment across teams.
cond_0474.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Degree in mathematics, statistics, or actuarial science
Fellowship of Society of Actuaries
Deep knowledge of VA business, reporting, and hedging
Strong computing and programming skills with experience in Python, C/C++, Matlab, VBA, SQL, etc.
Preferred Requirements
Strong communication skills, including the ability to explain trade-offs and walk colleagues through analytical findings
Adaptable to shifting business priorities

This individual will support the asset liability management team in creating tools to identify and measure the risk factors to earnings from product lines with embedded market risk. The individual will play a leading role in developing, improving, documenting hedge related analysis. The individual will require strong technical skill in model building, big data processing, analysis using MS Office, database and various programming language. People who do well in this role are often quick to grasp the logic of hedging strategies and actuarial risk analysis.
cond_0544.responsibilities:
Be a thought leader in hedging and risk management of variable annuities with living benefit riders (VA), fixed annuities (FA), and structured indexed annuities (SIA), IUL, through hedge strategy enhancement, capital and reserve determination, as well as product design and pricing.
Create and maintain models/tools which can perform business analysis with quick turnaround.
Identify and measure the impact to hedging program from risk factors, including but not limited to actuarial, market, regulatory change.
Propose enhancement and alteration to hedge procedure, instrument selection and hedge target based on risk analysis.
Improve attribution analysis with the focus to improve hedge effectiveness.
Document modeling approach, assumptions and core results.
Coordinate with business constituents in maintaining consistency in production process, implementation schedule, assumptions, modeling approach and regulatory and reporting.
cond_0544.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Degree in mathematics, statistics, or actuarial science
Fellowship of Society of Actuaries
Deep knowledge base on VA business, reporting and hedging
Strong computing and programming skills with experience in Python, c/c++, Matlab, VBA, SQL, etc.
Preferred Requirements
Adaptable to business priorities
Strong communication skills

cond_0613.intro: As a Sr. Director and Actuary, you'll support variable and fixed annuity asset liability management and risk assessment. This role reports to the Head of Strategic Analysis with a focus on hedge strategy enhancement, modeling, risk analysis, and documentation. This individual will support the asset liability management team in creating tools to identify and measure the risk factors to earnings from product lines with embedded market risk. The individual will play a leading role in developing, improving, documenting hedge related analysis. The individual will require strong technical skill in model building, big data processing, analysis using MS Office, database and various programming language.
cond_0613.responsibilities:
Be a thought leader in hedging and risk management of variable annuities with living benefit riders (VA), fixed annuities (FA), and structured indexed annuities (SIA), IUL, through hedge strategy enhancement, capital and reserve determination, as well as product design and pricing.
Create and maintain models/tools which can perform business analysis with quick turnaround.
Identify and measure the impact to hedging program from risk factors, including but not limited to actuarial, market, regulatory change.
Propose enhancement and alteration to hedge procedure, instrument selection and hedge target based on risk analysis.
Improve attribution analysis with the focus to improve hedge effectiveness.
Document modeling approach, assumptions and core results.
Coordinate with business constituents in maintaining consistency in production process, implementation schedule, assumptions, modeling approach and regulatory and reporting.
cond_0613.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Degree in mathematics, statistics, or actuarial science
Fellowship of Society of Actuaries
Deep knowledge base on VA business, reporting and hedging
Strong computing and programming skills with experience in Python, C/C++, Matlab, VBA, SQL, etc.
Preferred Requirements
Adaptable to business priorities
Strong communication skills
cond_0613.encouragement_text: Important: Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply.

cond_0648.intro: We are looking for a Sr. Director and Actuary to join our team.
cond_0648.responsibilities:
As a Sr. Director and Actuary, you'll support variable and fixed annuity asset liability management and risk assessment. This role reports to the Head of Strategic Analysis with a focus on hedge strategy enhancement, modeling, risk analysis, and documentation. You'll work alongside the asset liability management team to build tools that identify and measure the risk factors to earnings from product lines with embedded market risk. You'll coordinate closely with the team on developing, improving, and documenting hedge-related analysis, and will need strong technical skill in model building, big data processing, and analysis using MS Office, database tools, and various programming languages.
Contribute as a thought leader in hedging and risk management of variable annuities with living benefit riders (VA), fixed annuities (FA), and structured indexed annuities (SIA), IUL, through hedge strategy enhancement, capital and reserve determination, as well as product design and pricing.
Work with the team to create and maintain models/tools which can perform business analysis with quick turnaround.
Help identify and measure the impact to the hedging program from risk factors, including but not limited to actuarial, market, and regulatory change.
Share analysis and propose enhancements and alterations to hedge procedure, instrument selection, and hedge target based on risk findings.
Collaborate to improve attribution analysis with the focus to improve hedge effectiveness.
Document modeling approach, assumptions, and core results.
Coordinate with business constituents in maintaining consistency in production process, implementation schedule, assumptions, modeling approach, and regulatory and reporting.
cond_0648.requirements:
Degree in mathematics or statistics, or actuarial science
Fellowship of Society of Actuaries
Strong computing and programming skills with experience in Python, c/c++, Matlab, VBA, SQL, etc.
Deep knowledge base on VA business, reporting and hedging.
Adaptable to business priorities
Strong communication skills
